visual_input: unaltered RGB full image; original native smart_resize; no letterbox or image split; per-QA visual tensors/grid identical in four arms
ocr_reading_order: clipped original polygon envelope ymin,xmin,source detection index
ocr_text_normalization: NFC and whitespace collapse; remove empty; no spelling correction or reference normalization
ocr_reserved_token_escaping: render literal <| as < | and |> as | > to preserve chat/image token structure
ocr_packing: greedily include complete lines in reading order; if a line exceeds remaining context token budget skip it and continue; never cut a recognition string
ocr_deduplication: normalized whitespace text casefold; keep first in reading order
shuffle_rule: Sattolo derangement separately among empty and nonempty contexts; each nonempty source image differs; same unique-image context multiset, not guaranteed identical QA-weighted input length or compute

recognizer.cropping: official CropByPolys quad perspective transform; INTER_CUBIC/BORDER_REPLICATE; rotate tall crops at ratio>=1.5
recognizer.recognition_scope: all11205 legal detector polygons across1024 source images; raw text retained before fixed filtering
recognizer.confidence_interpretation: mean selected CTC character-frame confidence, not calibrated answer correctness

preflight.selection: first numeric dev question IDs; input-only; no score-based selection

statistics: one predeclared primary overall contrast; paired image-cluster bootstrap; secondary and frequency intervals pointwise exploratory unadjusted; fixed single checkpoint; point guards do not prove noninferiority or long-tail gains
confirmation_plan: If the full dev strong-baseline gate passes, review unchanged candidate for separately recorded fixed TextVQA final baseline+candidate confirmation; no official answer-based retuning.
limits: internal dev previously explored; not untouched holdout
OCR adds predicted textual information and total input tokens, not equal compute
cached VLM timing excludes historical detector/recognition preparation; no service acceleration claim
single checkpoint does not establish seed stability or capability retention
new source/config/output locks; do not reuse archived result identity after layout migration
cost_reporting: detector historical cached cost once per unique image
